conventions.origin: fixed initial galactic center (0,0,0); inertial axes; no recentering during integration
conventions.plane: legacy components use fixed z=0; diskFrame adds robust instantaneous global and local planes without changing state; geometric tilt differs from angular-momentum tilt
conventions.virial: W=sum m r.a from current forces, not potential U; surface terms unmeasured
conventions.orbit: initial unsoftened axisymmetric analytic model; spherical-component radii used as equatorial proxy
conventions.Q: conditional thin stellar disk diagnostic; finite thickness, non-axisymmetry and velocity-shape corrections not applied

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite NFW weak-field source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

conventions.origin: fixed initial galactic center (0,0,0); inertial axes; no recentering during integration
conventions.plane: legacy components use fixed z=0; diskFrame adds robust instantaneous global and local planes without changing state; geometric tilt differs from angular-momentum tilt
conventions.virial: W=sum m r.a from current forces, not potential U; surface terms unmeasured
conventions.orbit: initial unsoftened axisymmetric analytic model; spherical-component radii used as equatorial proxy
conventions.Q: conditional thin stellar disk diagnostic; finite thickness, non-axisymmetry and velocity-shape corrections not applied

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite NFW weak-field source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

analyticProfiles.method: Analytic initial density integrated over matching bins; disk midpoint quadrature 512 in u=z/sqrt(z²+b²); halo cumulative production table.
Analytic initial density integrated over matching bins; disk midpoint quadrature 512 in u=z/sqrt(z²+b²); halo cumulative production table.

conservation.energyMethod: Energia estimada — GPU Float32 + NFW estático

conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

conservation.precision: GPU Float32 pair potential; compensated CPU Float64 reduction, kinetic and static external energy
conservation.hamiltonian: K + U_baryon_pairs_Plummer + sum_i m_i Phi_NFW_static; no half on external term
conservation.arithmeticUncertainty: Float32 pair/field force arithmetic, not a certified error interval; compare independent Float64 Hamiltonian on snapshots.

conventions.origin: fixed initial galactic center (0,0,0); inertial axes; no recentering during integration

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite NFW weak-field source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

conventions.origin: fixed initial galactic center (0,0,0); inertial axes; no recentering during integration
conventions.plane: legacy components use fixed z=0; diskFrame adds robust instantaneous global and local planes without changing state; geometric tilt differs from angular-momentum tilt
conventions.virial: W=sum m r.a from current forces, not potential U; surface terms unmeasured
conventions.orbit: initial unsoftened axisymmetric analytic model; spherical-component radii used as equatorial proxy
conventions.Q: conditional thin stellar disk diagnostic; finite thickness, non-axisymmetry and velocity-shape corrections not applied

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite NFW weak-field source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

analyticProfiles.method: Analytic initial density integrated over matching bins; disk midpoint quadrature 512 in u=z/sqrt(z²+b²); halo cumulative production table.
Analytic initial density integrated over matching bins; disk midpoint quadrature 512 in u=z/sqrt(z²+b²); halo cumulative production table.

conservation.energyMethod: Energia estimada — GPU Float32 + NFW estático

conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

conservation.precision: GPU Float32 pair potential; compensated CPU Float64 reduction, kinetic and static external energy
conservation.hamiltonian: K + U_baryon_pairs_Plummer + sum_i m_i Phi_NFW_static; no half on external term
conservation.arithmeticUncertainty: Float32 pair/field force arithmetic, not a certified error interval; compare independent Float64 Hamiltonian on snapshots.

conventions.origin: fixed initial galactic center (0,0,0); inertial axes; no recentering during integration
conventions.plane: legacy components use fixed z=0; diskFrame adds robust instantaneous global and local planes without changing state; geometric tilt differs from angular-momentum tilt
conventions.virial: W=sum m r.a from current forces, not potential U; surface terms unmeasured
conventions.orbit: initial unsoftened axisymmetric analytic model; spherical-component radii used as equatorial proxy
conventions.Q: conditional thin stellar disk diagnostic; finite thickness, non-axisymmetry and velocity-shape corrections not applied

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.method: Direct WebGPU Float32 Plummer probe sums; Float64 azimuthal reduction; vc²=-R<ar>; squared contributions add. Halo: continuous finite NFW weak-field source, GPU Float32, no halo macroparticles.
rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

analyticProfiles.method: Analytic initial density integrated over matching bins; disk midpoint quadrature 512 in u=z/sqrt(z²+b²); halo cumulative production table.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

bhInitial.energyMethod: Energia estimada — GPU Float32 + NFW estático

conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

bhInitial.precision: GPU Float32 pair potential; compensated CPU Float64 reduction, kinetic and static external energy
bhInitial.hamiltonian: K + U_baryon_pairs_Plummer + sum_i m_i Phi_NFW_static; no half on external term
bhInitial.arithmeticUncertainty: Float32 pair/field force arithmetic, not a certified error interval; compare independent Float64 Hamiltonian on snapshots.

directInitial.energyMethod: Energia direta Float64 — pares bariônicos + NFW estático

conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

haloField.source: Same finite NFW mass profile and taper as models.js; Float32 effective constants/nodes recorded when GPU mode is used
haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

directInitial.hamiltonian: K + U_baryon_pairs_Plummer + sum_i m_i Phi_NFW_static; no half on external term
directInitial.arithmeticUncertainty: Not a formal interval; effective Float32 force/table constants recorded; independent Float64 energy evaluates the target Hamiltonian.

normalization.comparison: B = E_BH - E_dir; ΔB = B - B0; η = 100 ΔB / |E_dir(0)|. Native percentages with different denominators are not subtracted.

panels.fastHistory: Every measured energy epoch in this realization; no temporal decimation. Archived inputs may already be decimated: see source.

displayModes.directGuide: Dashed straight visual segments only; no extra measured samples

rotationField.qualification: Finite-N and angular-quadrature noise retained; Float32 force diagnostic, not observed particle rotation.

laboratory.qualification: Read-only diagnostics of actual integrated states. Direct measurements exist only at audited snapshots; dashed segments are visual guides. Float64 energy evaluation does not upgrade Float32 trajectories.

haloField.interpretation: Static material NFW source; leading nonrelativistic geodesics of weak-field GR. Not vacuum, not emergent dark matter, no full 1PN or Einstein evolution.

initial.comparison: Exact baryonic phase-array prefix of the same legacy seed/N0; no velocity rescaling; continuous halo centered at negative original centerShift, fixed in this inertial frame
